definitions.explanation: A disease or condition for which there is no known cure. A literary and somewhat formal expression.

examples.japanese: {不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: He fell ill with an incurable disease.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治療法|ちりょうほう}→治療法：27941_chiryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Diseases once considered incurable now have treatments.

examples.japanese: {不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きよう→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決意|けつい}した→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧。
examples.english: Diagnosed with a terminal illness, he resolved to live the rest of his life to the fullest.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat formal expression. In medical contexts, ⟦{難病|なんびょう}→難病：14606_nanbyou⟧ (intractable disease) is the more technical term. {不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい} carries dramatic weight and appears frequently in literature, drama, and news stories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (to contract an incurable disease)
- {不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be diagnosed with a terminal illness)
- {不治|ふじ}の{病|やまい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧ (to fight an incurable disease)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{難病|なんびょう}→難病：14606_nanbyou⟧: intractable disease — the medical/administrative term
- ⟦{末期|まっき}→末期：13032_makki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病|やまい}→病：13610_yamai⟧: terminal illness — emphasizes the final stage
